description: Composite XPS figure of the surface oxide film formed on Fe-Mn-Al-C low-density steels (LDSs) after 7200 s of potentiostatic polarization in 3.5 wt% NaCl. Twelve core-level spectra are supplied, each plotting Intensity (a.u.) versus Binding energy (eV) with coloured fitted components overlaid on the raw data: (b)-(d) Fe 2p (x-axis 704-720 eV), (b1)-(d1) Mn 2p (634-652 eV), (b2)-(d2) Al 2p (66-82 eV) and (b3)-(d3) O 1s (524-540 eV). Reading order pairs span the S950 ((b)-series), S1050 ((c)-series) and S1150 ((d)-series) samples; the S0 'a' series described in the caption is not present in the supplied images. Fe 2p is deconvoluted into Fe2+, Fe3+_OX and Fe3+_hy, with an additional low-intensity Fe2+_sat shoulder visible only in (b). Mn 2p in (b1) consists of a single Mn2+ peak, whereas (c1) and (d1) resolve Mn2+, Mn4+ plus an Mn2+_sat satellite. Every Al 2p panel shows one symmetric Al3+ peak near 74 eV, and every O 1s panel resolves OH-, H2O and O2- components. No numeric values are printed on any panel; peak positions are given only in the caption.

observations.observation: The supplied images contain only the S950, S1050 and S1150 blocks, labelled (b), (b1)-(b3), (c), (c1)-(c3), (d), (d1)-(d3); no (a)-series panel for S0 is present.
Every panel plots Intensity (a.u.) on the vertical axis against Binding energy (eV) on the horizontal axis, with coloured fitted component curves under the measured data.
The Fe 2p panel (b) for S950 carries the labels Fe2+_sat, Fe3+_hy, Fe3+_OX and Fe2+, while (c) and (d) show only Fe3+_hy, Fe3+_OX and Fe2+.
The Mn 2p panel (b1) for S950 shows a single highlighted Mn2+ peak, whereas (c1) and (d1) are fitted with three components labelled Mn2+_sat, Mn4+ and Mn2+.
All three Al 2p panels (b2, c2, d2) display one symmetric peak annotated Al3+ centred close to 74 eV.
All three O 1s panels (b3, c3, d3) are deconvoluted into three filled components annotated H2O, OH- and O2-.
No numeric values, peak areas, concentrations or percentages are printed on any panel; only sample letters and peak assignments appear.
The caption states the Fe 2p3/2 spectrum comprises FeOX2+ (709.8 eV), FeOX3+ (711.5 eV) and Fehy3+ (713.3 eV), with an extra satellite Fesat2+ (715.0 eV) only for S950.
The caption states Mn2p3/2 contains Mn2+ (640.4 eV), Mn4+ (641.8 eV) and satellite Mnsat2+ (646.2 eV) in all samples except S950, which displays only Mn2+ (640.4 eV).
The caption states the Al 2p spectrum is a single Al3+ peak at 74.1 eV attributed to Al2O3 and Al(OH)3.
The caption states O 1s consists of OH- (531.6 eV), H2O (533.2 eV) and O2- (529.7 eV), corresponding to hydroxides, crystalline water and oxides respectively.
The caption assigns panels to samples: (a-a1) S0, (b-b1) S950, (c-c1) S1050, (d-d1) S1150.
The citing text states XPS characterized the elemental composition and valence-state distribution of the surface oxide film after 7200 s of potentiostatic polarization in 3.5 wt% NaCl.
